proposals.title: Purchase conversions are under-valued: ₹435 per order in Google Ads vs ₹795 Shopify AOV
proposals.finding: Primary purchase action(s) ['Purchase {GTM>g-ads}'] report 64.6 conversions worth ₹28086 (30 days). Shopify's real average order is ₹795. Smart bidding (tROAS) is optimising on values about 55% of reality, so reported ROAS is understated and the bidder under-bids.
proposals.recommended_action: Fix the purchase tag so it sends the full order value (total incl. discounts, in INR) and a transaction_id. Easiest route: use the Shopify Google & YouTube app's conversion tracking (or Shopify's native Google Ads pixel) and set the GTM tag to secondary once the new one records correct values for 7 days.

execution.where: Google Ads > Goals > Conversions, and GTM / Shopify Customer Events
steps: Compare one test order's value in Google Ads vs Shopify
Fix the value variable
Keep only ONE primary purchase action

proposals.title: 4 products spent ₹4807 in Shopping with ~no return
proposals.finding: ₹500+ spend and 40+ clicks over 30 days with zero orders, or ROAS under 0.25. Zero orders is a count, so the value issue in ADS-004 doesn't explain it. Low-price items (e.g. ₹99 single-serves) can't pay back Shopping clicks even when they convert.
proposals.recommended_action: Exclude these items from the Sales-Shopping campaign for 30 days (listing-group exclusion), or lower their bids. Check their landing page price/stock first; several are PTG-feed duplicates of Shopify items that do convert.

proposals.title: 1 enabled campaign(s) got 0 impressions in 14 days: PTG Shopping - New Products Test
proposals.finding: Enabled and eligible but not serving. For Shopping, the usual cause is overlap: the same products are in another Shopping campaign with the same priority and a higher bid, so that campaign wins every auction.
proposals.recommended_action: Either set this campaign's Shopping priority to High (and the main campaign to Low/Medium), or exclude these products from the main Shopping campaign. Otherwise pause it to keep the account tidy.

execution.where: Google Ads > Campaign > Settings > Campaign priority
steps: Pick: raise priority / exclude from main campaign / pause

proposals.title: 2 non-purchase conversion actions are set as primary
proposals.finding: Primary actions are what smart bidding optimises for. Page views and YouTube follow-on views are not sales; if a campaign starts recording them, tROAS/Max-conversions will chase cheap clicks instead of orders.
proposals.recommended_action: Set these to Secondary so only Purchase drives bidding.

execution.where: Google Ads > Goals > Conversions > (action) > Edit > Secondary
steps: YouTube follow-on views
